records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_products
FROM products

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS seller_count
FROM sellers

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers
FROM customers

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_volume
FROM orders
WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_score
FROM reviews

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (review_score >= 4) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS positive_rate
FROM reviews

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value), 2) AS total_freight
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS category_count
FROM category_translation

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (review_score <= 2) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS negative_rate
FROM reviews

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', order_purchase_timestamp, order_delivered_customer_date)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND(SUM(payment_value) FILTER (payment_type = 'credit_card') / SUM(payment_value), 4) AS credit_card_ratio
FROM payments

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_state) AS state_count
FROM customers

SELECT ROUND(AVG(payment_installments), 2) AS avg_installments
FROM payments
WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(payment_value) FILTER (payment_installments > 1) / SUM(payment_value), 4) AS installment_rate
FROM payments

SELECT ROUND(MAX(payment_value), 2) AS max_single_payment
FROM payments

SELECT ROUND(MAX(price), 2) AS max_price
FROM order_items

SELECT MIN(order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS start_date,
       MAX(order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS end_date
FROM orders

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS delivered_orders
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_items_per_order
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS canceled_orders
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'canceled'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_freight_per_order
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_reviews
FROM reviews

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders_with_reviews
FROM reviews

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       COUNT(*) AS item_volume
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY item_volume DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT c.customer_city,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS unique_customer_count
FROM customers c
GROUP BY c.customer_city
ORDER BY unique_customer_count DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT s.seller_id,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY s.seller_id
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_score,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_volume
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY c.customer_state
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 100
ORDER BY avg_score ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (r.review_score <= 2) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS negative_rate,
       COUNT(*) AS review_count
FROM reviews r
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english
HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
ORDER BY negative_rate DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT payment_type,
       COUNT(*) AS payment_count,
       ROUND(SUM(payment_value), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payments
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY payment_type

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (cnt >= 2) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS repurchase_rate
FROM (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt
  FROM customers c
  JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
) t

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND c.customer_state = 'SP'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH top_categories AS (
    SELECT p.product_category_name
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    GROUP BY p.product_category_name
    ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_score
FROM top_categories tc
JOIN products p ON p.product_category_name = tc.product_category_name
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT s.seller_id,
       COUNT(*) AS bad_review_count
FROM reviews r
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
WHERE r.review_score <= 2
GROUP BY s.seller_id
ORDER BY bad_review_count DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT c.customer_state,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_volume
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY order_volume DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_state
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 100
ORDER BY avg_delivery_days ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id), 2) AS avg_freight_per_order
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY avg_freight_per_order DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value) FILTER (p.payment_type = 'boleto') / SUM(p.payment_value), 4) AS boleto_ratio
FROM payments p
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY boleto_ratio DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
       COUNT(*) AS item_count
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY item_count DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH review_counts AS (
    SELECT p.product_category_name,
           COUNT(*) AS total_reviews,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (review_comment_message IS NOT NULL AND review_comment_message != '') AS text_reviews
    FROM reviews r
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_category_name
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
)
SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(text_reviews * 1.0 / total_reviews, 4) AS text_review_ratio
FROM review_counts rc
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = rc.product_category_name
ORDER BY text_review_ratio DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT s.seller_id,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_score
FROM sellers s
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY s.seller_id
HAVING COUNT(r.review_id) >= 50
ORDER BY avg_score DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value) / SUM(oi.price), 4) AS freight_ratio
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY freight_ratio DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH state_payment AS (
    SELECT c.customer_state,
           p.payment_type,
           ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value), 2) AS total_payment
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    GROUP BY c.customer_state, p.payment_type
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT customer_state,
           payment_type,
           total_payment,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_state ORDER BY total_payment DESC) AS rn
    FROM state_payment
)
SELECT customer_state,
       payment_type,
       total_payment
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY customer_state

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_volume
FROM orders
WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', review_creation_date)::DATE AS month,
       ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_score
FROM reviews
WHERE review_creation_date >= DATE '2017-01-01'
  AND review_creation_date < DATE '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-10-17'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-10-17'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_volume
FROM orders
WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-07-17'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-10-17'

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 1 THEN '2018Q1' ELSE '2018Q2' END AS quarter,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-07-01'
  AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) IN (1, 2)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH first_order AS (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
           MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_purchase
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', first_purchase)::DATE AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS new_customers
FROM first_order
WHERE first_purchase >= DATE '2018-01-01'
  AND first_purchase < DATE '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH revenue_2017 AS (
    SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS rev
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
),
revenue_2018 AS (
    SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS rev
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018
)
SELECT ROUND((r2018.rev - r2017.rev) / r2017.rev, 4) AS growth_rate
FROM revenue_2017 r2017, revenue_2018 r2018

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_volume
FROM orders
WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-04-17'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-10-18'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS VARCHAR), 'Q', CAST(EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS VARCHAR)) AS quarter,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
         ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-08-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-10-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ROUND((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 4) AS change_rate
FROM monthly_revenue
WHERE month = DATE '2018-09-01'

SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT('dow' FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 0 THEN 'Sunday'
            WHEN EXTRACT('dow' FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 1 THEN 'Monday'
            WHEN EXTRACT('dow' FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2 THEN 'Tuesday'
            WHEN EXTRACT('dow' FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 3 THEN 'Wednesday'
            WHEN EXTRACT('dow' FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 4 THEN 'Thursday'
            WHEN EXTRACT('dow' FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 5 THEN 'Friday'
            WHEN EXTRACT('dow' FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 6 THEN 'Saturday'
       END AS day_of_week,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_volume
FROM orders
WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY EXTRACT('dow' FROM order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY order_volume DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS hour,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_volume
FROM orders
WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY order_volume DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
       ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders o
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN review_creation_date >= DATE '2017-10-17' AND review_creation_date < DATE '2018-10-17' THEN 'recent_year'
    WHEN review_creation_date >= DATE '2016-10-17' AND review_creation_date < DATE '2017-10-17' THEN 'previous_year'
  END AS period,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (review_score >= 4) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS positive_rate
FROM reviews
WHERE review_creation_date >= DATE '2016-10-17' AND review_creation_date < DATE '2018-10-17'
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period

SELECT CONCAT('2017', EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS quarter,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
GROUP BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)

WITH yearly_category_revenue AS (
    SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year,
           ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
           ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018)
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT year, category, revenue,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rn
    FROM yearly_category_revenue
)
SELECT year, category, revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY year, rn
